name: TwistingData.sum_deepIndicator
summary: deepIndicator(b, s) + deepIndicator(b, s − 1) = 1 since parities alternate; summing over s gives 2·Σ = N.

steps.claim: It suffices to show 2·Σ_s deepIndicator T r (b, s) = N (then the sum is N/2; 2 ≠ 0).

2·Σ_s f(s) = Σ_s f(s) + Σ_s f(s − 1) (translation invariance of the sum over ℤ/N) = Σ_s (f(s) + f(s − 1)), and f(s) + f(s − 1) = 1 for every s, as isEven(s) = not isEven(s − 1) (isEven_succ); Σ_s 1 = N.
steps.lean:
(by nth_rw 1 [two_mul, ← sum_translate (-1), ← sum_add_distrib, sum_const_nat,
  mul_one] <;> simp; grind [deepIndicator, isEven_succ])
